description: This file serves as the package initializer for the 'universalinit-env' package, providing metadata, importing core components, and defining exports for the package.

methods.name: get_template_path
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the template directory or file, likely for environment configuration.

methods.name: parse_template_file
methods.description: Parses a template file, possibly to extract environment variable mappings or configurations.

methods.name: map_common_to_framework
methods.description: Converts a standard (common) environment configuration to a specific framework's format.

methods.name: map_framework_to_common
methods.description: Converts a framework-specific environment configuration back to a common format.

methods.name: get_supported_frameworks
methods.description: Returns a list of frameworks supported by the package.

methods.name: apply_wildcard_mapping
methods.description: Applies wildcard or pattern-based mappings to environment variables.
